children: announces that, further to its news releases dated July 27, 2026 and September 1, 2026, it has received acceptance from the TSX Venture Exchange for its one-for-4 share consolidation. The consolidation will be effective at the market opening on Friday, October 16, 2026. GGL's name will be unchanged, and its common shares will continue to trade under the symbol GGL on the TSX Venture Exchange. GGL's new ISIN number is CA36171B4091, and its new CUSIP number is 36171B409.
In accordance with GGL's Articles and By-Laws, the consolidation was approved by the Board of Directors, as shareholder approval was not required.
The principle effects of the consolidation will be that:
the number of shares issued and outstanding will be reduced from 104,357,475 shares to approximately 26,089,368 shares; and

the exercise or conversion price and/or the number of shares issuable upon any of GGL's outstanding stock options and warrants will be proportionately adjusted after giving effect to the consolidation.
